title: anil lyallii
intro: Anil lyallii, commonly known as New Zealand anise tree, is a species of flowering plant in the myrtle family. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma by loosening and removing mucus. The therapeutic actions of Anil lyallii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may also help soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
